name: Hosts Config
description: Keep hosts, folders and sharing in a YAML or JSON file. Termix loads them as read only hosts and reloads when the file changes.
features: SSH, RDP, VNC, Telnet and any plugin protocol from one YAML or JSON file
Hosts from the file are read only, while pins and order stay with each user
Secrets from env vars, files or saved credentials, never written in the file
Shares with users and roles, per host or per folder
Turn plugin features on or off per host
Reloads when the file changes, with clear errors when it can't apply
Strict mode so every host comes from the file

env.name: TERMIX_HOSTS_CONFIG
env.description: Path to the hosts file (.yaml, .yml or .json). Unset means the plugin loads nothing and locks no hosts.
